future_check: Replay all canonical pairs and the strict semantic census whenever the scene grammar or oracle changes.
rationale: Each top key color owns the immediately down-right 2x2 color-1 mask. Every separated lower 2x2 tile uses its bottom-right color as a key and stamps that mask into the output; color-5 tiles remain blank.
summary: Generate the actual legend-to-lattice mask-copy grammar instead of a visually similar anchor task.

future_check: Broaden profiles only after an independent source, held-out example, or reviewed rule argument establishes additional lawful shapes.
rationale: This maximizes fidelity to the available task evidence but may under-span lawful hidden variants if the true rule permits additional lattice shapes or key counts.
summary: The generator intentionally stays within the three observed canonical dimension profiles.

future_check: Compare generated feature support against canonical blank-count and mask-size ranges, not only dimensions and palette size.
rationale: An intermediate candidate passed generic gates while emitting one blank tile and mask sizes outside the demos. The final generator uses mask-size multisets [3,3,4] or [3,3,3,4] and five or six blank tiles, matching all three canonical scenes.
summary: Constrain generated mask sizes and blank counts to the observed canonical support.

future_check: Use a shared axis-enumeration helper in future task-local evidence scripts.
rationale: The task-local evidence helper failed after blank_zone was removed; changing it to iterate AXES eliminated stale-axis coupling.
summary: Evidence helpers should enumerate the live AXES declaration instead of hardcoding axis names.

future_check: Regenerate override cases from the live AXES declaration and require every accepted value to be recoverable from pixels.
rationale: The baseline declared singleton, swallowed, or provenance-free axes. The repaired axes are profile, key_row, key_stride, probe_mask_size, and blank_count; unknown keys fail fast.
summary: Expose only five live, pixel-observable override axes.

future_check: Continue role-aware exact-sync validation and execution parity for every distinct executable source text.
rationale: The canonical program_solution and task-local target_code now have one exact hash group and RULE_HASH 7e9649df4812. raw_code remains textually distinct by role but executes correctly on every canonical pair.
summary: Synchronize the selected target rule exactly while preserving the richer archival raw Racket source.

future_check: Keep a firing witness tied to every declared rival and fail strict semantics when a rival lacks a counterexample.
rationale: All three alternatives can fit superficial layout cues but fail when sparse masks differ by key or when an unkeyed color-5 tile must remain blank.
summary: Explicitly refute solid-fill, first-mask-for-all, and paint-blank-tile shortcuts.

future_check: Require nonzero exact canonical-profile support and canonical self_check acceptance before accepting future rewrites.
rationale: The baseline emitted small scenes with isolated anchors and could not produce the canonical 17x18, 18x20, or 20x18 profiles; two canonical inputs also failed self_check.
